hook: Your flight over Peru would show a giant monkey.
title: A Giant Monkey Is Drawn Into Peru's Desert
description:
The Nazca Lines in Peru include a monkey, a hummingbird and a spider drawn into the desert floor. They are around 2,000 years old and are best seen from the air. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Nazca #Peru
